history.created_by: LABEL org.opencontainers.image.title=Mailpit org.opencontainers.image.description=An email and SMTP testing tool with API for developers org.opencontainers.image.source=https://github.com/axllent/mailpit org.opencontainers.image.url=https://mailpit.axllent.org org.opencontainers.image.documentation=https://mailpit.axllent.org/docs/ org.opencontainers.image.licenses=MIT
RUN /bin/sh -c apk upgrade --no-cache && apk add --no-cache tzdata &&     ln -sf /mailpit /usr/sbin/sendmail &&     ln -sf /mailpit /usr/local/bin/sendmail # buildkit
HEALTHCHECK {Test:[CMD /mailpit readyz] Interval:15s Timeout:0s StartPeriod:10s StartInterval:1s Retries:0}
